title: Cigarette identity, tracking and object-only blur - required before Studio production installation

existing_evidence.false_positive: 886_5 known microphone ornament, original YOLOWorld class smoking cigarette; 24 user-confirmed non-cigarette frames
existing_evidence.negative_review: 886_5 101 source samples, no clearly visible cigarette; every-4-second samples insufficient to prove negative
existing_evidence.synthetic_test: Three-module fail-closed shadow package offline tests pass, no independent semantic verifier or full video GPU test
existing_evidence.release_hold: 886_5 semantic quarantine active after false blur removed

required_ground_truth.positive: At least one real segment from user's own stream where a cigarette is clearly visible, preferably moving, with exact stream ID and timecode (or direct 5-20 second clip)
required_ground_truth.negative: User-confirmed 886_5 microphone ornament at 9558.9..9561.2 source time
required_ground_truth.key_principle: Real image ground truth must be independent of YOLOWorld predictions. Never label YOLOWorld outputs automatically.

acceptance_gates: Independent image-identity verifier agrees on actual cigarette candidate; never infer identity from tracking stability or one YOLOWorld score
All known negative microphone frames must be rejected; do not exclude the entire microphone area because a genuine cigarette may enter
On frame-level positive ground truth, count missed visible-cigarette frames, identity switches, drift onto hands or microphone, and duration of uncertainty
Blur only the visible cigarette or tight mask/ROI following motion. Do not blur whole frame or face, hand, mic, or background when cigarette not present
If occluded or visually uncertain, flag as unresolved and block automatic release; do not fill unknown frames with invented coordinates
Do not report clean dialogue based on 3fps coarse scan and sparse 12fps refinement alone; verify full retained-video temporal coverage
No production XML/audio source modified until independent identity evidence and smoke QA pass. Stage to temp, verify, then atomic replace
Preserve existing original audio and non-cigarette Premiere tracks exactly; no full 886 rerun
No new large model, WSL, CUDA stack or optional dependencies installed until licenses, VRAM and readiness checked in shadow runtime
next_action: Request one real cigarette positive clip or exact stream ID+timestamp, then run matched negative-vs-positive semantic shadow benchmark on the GPU without modifying Studio.
status_notes: Commit of this document only; it is not a production implementation nor a tested independent model.
